thread:
maria: Heads up — a customer hit a regression when using JSON/structured output with smart routing ON. They send structured_json=true and suddenly our parser fails. x-request-id=7a3b9f2c
kevin: Can you paste the raw response they got?
maria: Paste from their logs below. They expect an object, but we returned a quoted string and a missing top-level key.
```json
// expected
{"metadata":{"user_id":"acme-42"},"result":[{"id":0,"text":"ok"}]}
```
```text
// actual returned body
"{\"result\":[{\"id\":0,\"text\":\"ok\"}]}"
// note: metadata key is missing and the response is wrapped in a string
```
ops-bot: SmartRouting: handoff executed. route_id=sr-21, chosen_pool=small-quant-rt, reason=region_capacity_preserve, fallback_policy=async_handoff
lucas: That small-quant runtime sometimes returns pre-serialized strings for streaming efficiency. We should not let that violate structured_json mode — runtime should normalize. Investigating why the normalizer didn't run.
sre-ella: Customer impact? blocking?
maria: Blocking for them, they reject parse and the downstream service fails (500). They want immediate workaround.
kevin: Workaround options: 1) Pin model to a structured-capable model (e.g., model: "redwood-structured-1.2") 2) Set smart_routing=false for that API key 3) Add a lightweight pre-parse that strips leading/trailing quotes before JSON parse (ugly). Recommend pin for now.
lucas: Repro steps from our side: curl to staging with structured_json=true and a payload that triggers routing (long prompt, region=eu-west). Example:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer x" -H "X-Request-ID: 7a3b9f2c" \
  -d '{"prompt":"...long...","structured_json":true}' \
  https://api.redwood-staging.com/v1/generate
```
We can reproduce and see the handoff log.
maria: Customer wants ETA. Any chance for a patch soon?
lucas: I found the bug: async handoff path skips the post-process step when the model returns a single chunk that is tagged as preformatted. Patch will re-run the normalizer and also add a schema_check when structured_json=true. I'll push a hotfix to canary (eng-runtime) in ~30m.
sre-ella: Can you add a feature gate so that schema_check is enforced for production keys flagged as strict? We should avoid perf regressions for general users.
lucas: Yep — will gate it behind strict_schema=true on the route. Default stays off. For safety, we will enable it for any customer that requested strict parsing via customer settings.
kevin: I'll update the customer with the pin workaround and ETA for hotfix. Also log suggested mitigation in the incident tracker. @billing-bot any billing implications?
billing-bot: No billing changes expected; this is a routing/runtime behavior only.
maria: Thanks team. After hotfix, can we run their failing prompt through the canary? I'll coordinate with the customer for a quick test. :thumbsup:
lucas: Will post canary link and deploy notes once ready. Expect follow-up in ~45m. :eyes:
